name: C1 Courtside Deck v2
format: Standalone interactive HTML; all fonts, styles, scripts and synthetic media embedded
changes: Review counts and progress above the video; no progress inside the decision card
Local rally timeline with live duration, playhead and separate draggable start/end targets
Keep, Remove, Near and Far actions without redundant category labels
Exact source seeking stays in Browse; gaps highlight Add missing rally
Explicit missing action preserves source position on entry to Editor
Source seeking scrolls to the matching or nearest chronological rally
isolation: Read shared bootstrap and index, Taste skill with its app-screen reference/scripts, and the supplied C1 baseline only. No delegation, other design skills, application-source edits, comparison edits or other agents' artifacts.
assets: Original embedded WOFF2 subsets and synthetic frame preserved byte-for-byte. Reuse the parent-provided IBM Plex Sans font license for distribution.
process: .process/ contains ignored build, interaction-check and screenshot evidence
limitations: Media and session persistence are simulated locally
Physical touch, native pointer capture and screen-reader behavior require manual verification
